verdict.rationale: Muse supports goal/task-based automation that 'continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up' and sends notifications when action is needed, which matches event-triggered automatic action (muse-docs-20, muse-docs-24, muse-docs-26). However this is framed as agent-managed goal tracking rather than a user-defined explicit rule/trigger system, and a hands-on community report found the agent's control architecture failed under stress testing (muse-comm-1), raising doubts about reliability of this automation loop. Missing for 10: an explicit rule-definition interface (if/then conditions), documentation of user-authored triggers rather than agent-inferred goals, and independent verification that scheduled/event-based follow-through works reliably at scale.
